get.description: Returns a list of proxy tokens belonging to the current user. Each token includes metadata such as fingerprint, name, active status, and associated device serial numbers. Token secrets are not exposed in this response.

200.description: List of proxy tokens has been returned.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue the token and try again.

post.description: Creates a proxy token for the current user. The generated token secret is returned in the response body and cannot be retrieved afterwards. The token name must be unique per user.

200.description: Proxy token has been created. The response body contains the full token object, including the secret. Save the secret, as it cannot be retrieved later.

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue the token and try again.

409.description: Token with the provided name already exists for this user.

delete.description: Deletes the specified proxy token using its unique fingerprint. Any active connections that rely on this token are immediately terminated.

parameters.name: fingerprint
parameters.description: Unique fingerprint of the proxy token to delete.

200.description: Proxy token has been deleted. The response body contains the metadata of the removed token.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue the token and try again.

404.description: No proxy token with the provided fingerprint exists for this user.

entity.FirewallRuleBodyReq.description:
Request body for creating (POST) or updating (PATCH) a firewall rule.
All fields are required for creation. For updates, you may send only the fields to be changed.

action.description: Specifies whether to permit (allow) or block (deny) traffic matching this rule.

address.description: Destination address. Available values are IPv4, IPv6, subnet, domain, or "*".

ports.description: Destination port. Available values are a single port, a range (e.g., "8000:9000"), or "*".

entity.FirewallRulePriorityBodyReq.description: Request body for reordering firewall rules by priority.

ids.description:
List of rule identifiers in the desired order of execution priority.
The first rule in the list has the highest priority.
Priority is important only for IP-based rules when overlapping subnets exist (e.g., denying `172.0.0.1` but allowing `172.0.0.0/24`).

start.description: The start time of the slot.

stop.description: The stop time of the slot.

slot.description: Abstract unit to which a device belongs. If you have a monthly subscription, you can replace devices in a slot.

connected.description: Indicates if the device is connected to a network.

failover.description: Indicates if fail over is enabled.

roaming.description: Indicates if the device is roaming.

billingType.description: The tariffication type for the device. Available values are minutes, hours, and months.

name.description: Identifier of the user who controls the device.

iccid.description: The integrated circuit card identifier (ICCID) of the phone.

imei.description: The international mobile equipment identity (IMEI) of the phone.

imsi.description: The international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) of the phone.

entity.ProxyToken.description: Full token object returned only immediately after creation. The `token` field contains the actual secret value and is never returned again.

active.description: Indicates whether the token is currently active (enabled). Inactive tokens cannot forward traffic.

fingerprint.description: Unique immutable identifier of the token (hash of the public key or generated ID). Used as a path parameter for delete/update operations.

token.description: The proxy token secret. This value is only returned after creation. Store it securely, as it cannot be retrieved later.

entity.ProxyTokenInfo.description: Token metadata returned in list responses. The actual `token` secret is omitted for security, but associated device serials are shown.

active.description: Indicates whether the token is active.

serials.description: List of device serial numbers that are currently using this proxy token to forward traffic.

ports.description: Destination port. Available values are a single port, a range (e.g., "8000:9000"), or "*".

entity.DeviceSettingsChangeBody.description: Request body for changing device settings. At least one of the fields (`proxy` or `wifi`) must be provided.

proxy.description: Proxy tunnel configuration. `token_fingerprint` is required only when `enable = true`.

wifi.description: Indicates whether the Wi-Fi configuration should be added or removed on the device. If true, the Wi-Fi configuration is added or enabled. If false, it is removed or disabled.

entity.DeviceProxySettings.description: Proxy tunnel configuration for the device.

enable.description: Indicates whether the proxy tunnel configuration should be added or removed on the device. If true, the proxy tunnel is added or enabled. If false, it is removed or disabled.

token_fingerprint.description: Unique fingerprint of the existing and active proxy token to be used for the tunnel. Required when `enable` is `true`.
